findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "toolfound_submit_product" is 953 chars, far longer than this server's median (187). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: toolfound_launch_readiness, toolfound_search_tools, toolfound_get_product, toolfound_get_alternatives, toolfound_submit_product, toolfound_check_verification, toolfound_get_launch_status, toolfound_claim_listing · Private data: toolfound_inspect_public_link, toolfound_check_verification, toolfound_verify_submission · Public sink: toolfound_share_preview, toolfound_get_product, toolfound_submit_product, toolfound_check_verification, toolfound_verify_submission, toolfound_claim_listing · Destructive: toolfound_directory_matcher, toolfound_campaign_url_cleaner, toolfound_check_verification.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: toolfound_launch_readiness, toolfound_search_tools, toolfound_get_product, toolfound_get_alternatives, toolfound_submit_product, toolfound_check_verification, toolfound_get_launch_status, toolfound_claim_listing · Private data: toolfound_inspect_public_link, toolfound_check_verification, toolfound_verify_submission · Public sink: toolfound_share_preview, toolfound_get_product, toolfound_submit_product, toolfound_check_verification, toolfound_verify_submission, toolfound_claim_listing · Destructive: toolfound_directory_matcher, toolfound_campaign_url_cleaner, toolfound_check_verification

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
